title: Lettuce Dragon Crystal Ball
description: A surreal fantasy scene features a large vibrant green lettuce with a small green dragon breathing fire from its center. In front stands a glowing crystal ball on a stone pedestal labeled 'SLOT-32 / SEED-LETTUCE' containing three running horses, topped by a yellow chick with a pink hat. To the right, three identical white-haired women in white outfits strike dynamic magical poses with blue energy and pink orbs.
prompt: Surreal fantasy scene with a giant green lettuce head growing from the ground containing a small green dragon with purple wings breathing fire. A glowing blue crystal ball on a stone pedestal displays three running brown horses inside, with a yellow baby chick wearing a pink hat perched on top. To the right, three identical white-haired women in revealing white outfits perform magical poses with blue energy shards and floating pink orbs. Colorful energy streams in pink, orange and blue flow across a dark garden background with cabbages.
